dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three primary 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper dorsal region exhibit sharp pixel intensity transitions from high-intensity perimeters to low-intensity interiors. The perimeters are irregular and range from 2 to 5 pixels in width.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Dense concentration of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior neck region. A secondary grouping of larger, asymmetrical blobs lacking internal gradients is distributed along the mid-lateral line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented toward the longitudinal axis. A cluster of four high-intensity blobs in the lower anterior region forms a trapezoidal spatial relationship.
